prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-02 for page 26-X-04-subscription-management, state default. Reference state: no subscription management screen. Make this concept status-first: the user immediately sees they have no active paid plan and can start a subscription or read policy help.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS frame, device frame, or watermark. Preserve sidebar. Header: 구독 관리. Main: top status panel with '현재 구독 없음', current access badge, Obsidian start subscription CTA. Under it: payment history table with columns 결제일/금액/상태/영수증 and empty state. Right side: stacked help cards for change policy, refund standard, plan comparison, support inquiry button. Footer actions: go to subscription start, back.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-compatible account UI, compact, neutral, trustworthy, no commerce landing page.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian. Obsidian primary start CTA only. Gray empty table, muted info surfaces, no colorful plan banners.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, compact table labels.
Must preserve state signals: no current subscription, start subscription, empty payment history, policy/refund/plan help, support inquiry, subscription start/back navigation.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud gradients, colorful buttons, decorative billing artwork, heavy shadow cards, overly rounded panels.
